judged_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:14-16 — `execute` gates on all three settings (`feed_polling_enabled?`, `feed_polling_url.present?`, `embed_by_username.present?`) but `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` (lib/topic_retriever.rb:50) only checks `embed_by_username`, so the two gating paths for essentially the same import capability are inconsistent, meaning disabling feed polling does not disable on-demand remote import via embed requests.

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Jobs::PollFeed#execute` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) is specifically an RSS/ATOM polling job and appropriately gates on `feed_polling_enabled?`, `feed_polling_url.present?`, and `embed_by_username.present?`. `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` (lib/topic_retriever.rb) is a different path: it performs an on-demand HTTP fetch of a single `@embed_url` via `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, and it is already gated by `invalid_host?` (which depends on `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`) and by requiring `embed_by_username` to resolve a user. The diff does not show any requirement or intent that `feed_polling_enabled?` should disable on-demand remote import; the setting name and usage indicate it controls only feed polling, not embedding/on-demand retrieval. Therefore the claimed "inconsistency"/"disabling feed polling does not disable on-demand remote import" is not a verifiable defect from the diff.
